correctness.rationale: The Cayley-square transform y=((1+x)/(1-x))^2 yields the exact step F_t(y)=t y+1/2+1/(16ty), t=[(1+a)/(2(1-a))]^2. For a neutral m-word, composing formal y->infinity expansions gives G(y)=y+B+C/y+O(y^-2), B=sum 1/(2R_j), C=sum 1/(16R_j^2); positivity gives G(y)>y+B for every finite y, so all admissible orbits grow. Summability of increments of Y_n-Bn-(C/B)log n (order log n/n^2) produces finite L and stated O(log n/n) tail. Adjacent swaps change only one prefix R_i, proving the unique B,C maximizing/minimizing monotone orders up to ties. Independently computed exact B,C for k=1,2,3,5,9 grouped a=1/7,b=1/2 and alternating schedules, verifying exponential vs linear separation and neutral products. The logarithmic coefficient is C/B and is not claimed separately sorted-optimal.
